title: String Compression
description: Compress a string by replacing consecutive repeated characters with count.

data.text: Compress a string by replacing sequences of the same character with the character followed by the count of consecutive occurrences. Return the compressed string.

data.title: SB O(n)
Span O(n) fewer allocations
What improved?
data.text: Pre-sizing `StringBuilder` avoids internal buffer resizing. The algorithm itself is the same; the win is fewer allocations and copies.
